candidate_workaround: Whitelist the exact declared closeout output paths as regenerable owner-local surfaces while retaining rejection of every undeclared path.
failure_signature: The second closeout build rejected all artifacts written by the successful first build because its preflight allowed scaffolding but not its own exact output set.
recurrence_guard: A regenerable builder must declare every exact output path in its preflight contract; never replace the list with a directory-wide wildcard.
rollback: Give the rejected regeneration zero artifact credit, retain the exact unexpected-path list, and delete or mutate no prior artifact.
scope_boundary: Owner-local closeout-generation idempotence only; no sibling mutation, manifest, seal, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
title: Declare exact regenerable closeout outputs
trigger_preconditions: A bounded owner-local generator may need to refresh its already generated outputs before staging.
